summary: Now sole owner of the former Maybourne Saint-Germain, Constellation Hotels (led by Gianluca Muzzi) is taking back management and branding. Neil Jacobs, ex-CEO of Six Senses, is building its operating platform, with a new brand collection due before year-end. The name 'Le Saint-Germain' is reported by CFNEWS IMMO and still to be confirmed.
title: Constellation Hotels takes back its Paris flagship
why: Owners of trophy assets increasingly want to control the brand, not just the walls. A new luxury operator is born from The Connaught, The Berkeley and The Emory.
